info.name: Lancaster EPrints OAI-PMH 2.0 Interface Oai2 API

params.name: metadataPrefix
params.description: Metadata format to disseminate. Required for ListRecords, ListIdentifiers, and GetRecord (unless a resumptionToken is used). Observed supported formats on this repository.

params.name: identifier
params.description: OAI item identifier, e.g. oai:eprints.lancs.ac.uk:10175. Required for GetRecord.

params.name: set
params.description: Set spec to selectively harvest a subset of records.

params.name: from
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for selective harvesting by datestamp. Granularity YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

params.name: until
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for selective harvesting by datestamp. Granularity YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

params.name: resumptionToken
params.description: Flow-control token returned in an incomplete list response; used to request the next page. Exclusive of other selective arguments.

items.docs: Single OAI-PMH endpoint. The "verb" parameter selects the operation. Responses are OAI-PMH XML envelopes (Content-Type text/xml). Parameter applicability depends on the verb per the OAI-PMH 2.0 specification.
